D: A banjo-playing frog leaves his Florida swamp for Hollywood and picks up a bear, a pig, a whatever and a rock band on the way, with a frog legs tycoon on his tail.
P: Bring out the chilli when the gang sits round the campfire in the desert.
S: Corn chips with beans and melted cheese. Fozzie bombs at the El Sleezo.

Warm the beans with the cumin and a splash of water, mashing a few. Mix the tomato and onion with half the lime juice and a pinch of salt. Layer the chips, beans and cheese twice in a baking dish and bake at 200C until the cheese bubbles. Mash the avocado with the rest of the lime and top the nachos with salsa, avocado and sour cream.
Corn cobs with honey chilli butter, from the Bogen County Fair where Piggy wins

Mash the butter with the honey, chilli and a pinch of salt. Boil the corn for 4 minutes, then drain. Grill or pan-char the cobs, turning, until spotted brown all over. Brush with the honey butter, scatter with parmesan and serve with lime.
M: Buttermilk fried chicken drumsticks, not frog legs. Kermit turns Hopper down.

Soak the drumsticks in the buttermilk with a big pinch of salt for at least an hour. Mix the flour with the paprika, garlic powder and salt, and dredge the drumsticks well. Fry in oil at 160C in batches, turning, until deep golden and cooked through. Toss the cabbage and carrot with the mayo and vinegar. Drain the chicken and serve with the slaw and hot sauce.
Beef and bean chilli. Stuck at a desert campfire under the stars.

Brown the mince in batches, then soften the onion and garlic in the same pan. Stir in the spices, tomatoes, beans and stock and simmer gently, stirring now and then. Whisk the polenta, flour, milk, eggs, butter and a pinch of salt into a batter. Pour into a hot greased skillet and bake at 200C until golden and springy. Serve the chilli in bowls with wedges of cornbread.
W: Ice cream sundaes with chocolate fudge, for Kermit's banjo and the Rainbow Connection

Heat the cream and golden syrup, pour over the chocolate and stir until glossy. Scoop the ice cream into 4 tall glasses with the strawberries and banana. Pour over the warm fudge sauce, shower with sprinkles and top each with a cherry.
K: Sparkling grape juice with frozen grapes, the waiter's Idaho fizz
Drop a few frozen grapes into 4 chilled glasses. Fill two thirds with the grape juice, top with soda and add a twist of lemon.
